name.title: Name
name.description: You shouldn't need to change this.

hideHeaterAutoMode.title: Hide Heater Auto Mode
hideHeaterAutoMode.description: Hides Auto and disables fixed heat-level control in HomeKit. Heat still selects Eco and Cool still selects fan-only.

ignoreHeaterPowerOnWithTemperature.title: Ignore Heater Power-On With Temperature Changes
ignoreHeaterPowerOnWithTemperature.description: Saves temperature changes while a heater is off and suppresses power-on requests near a heater temperature write.

hideTemperatureSensor.title: Hide Fan Temperature Sensor
hideTemperatureSensor.description: Enable this option to hide the temperature sensor.

temperatureOffset.title: Fan Temperature Offset
temperatureOffset.description: Subtract (or add) a set amount from the temperature reading (use negative numbers to subtract). This setting only applies to fans.
